guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以「將防滲、排水、沉陷與植生整合為掩埋場最終覆蓋證據」為主軸，依序處理覆蓋層功能分工、低滲透層完整性、差異沉陷與裂縫、植生含水與季節、巡查空間覆蓋。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on Integrate infiltration control, drainage, settlement and vegetation into landfill-cover evidence, progressing through Roles of cover layers, Integrity of the low-permeability layer, Differential settlement and cracking, Vegetation moisture and seasonality, Inspection spatial coverage. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
procedure: 只將 rho 改成 1200 kg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4 變成 5 m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 P 改成 0.10 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 200 變成 400 m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 K 改成 2e-9 m/s，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.1728 變成 0.3456 m³/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Δz 改成 1.0 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變成 2 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Δs 改成 0.12 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.01 變成 0.015 m/m。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 F 改成 600 N，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 10 變成 12 MPa。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將濕基含水率 w 改成 0.40，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 700 變成 600 kg dry solids。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 c 改成 0.80，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 27 變成 17 m³ CH₄/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 a 改成 300 m²，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 25 變成 34 sample cells。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 n 改成 1200，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 91.6667 變成 83.3333 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
procedureEn: Change only bulk density rho to 1200 kg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4 to 5 m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only P to 0.10 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 200 to 400 m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only K to 2e-9 m/s, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.1728 to 0.3456 m³/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Δz to 1.0 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 3 to 2 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Δs to 0.12 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.01 to 0.015 m/m. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only F to 600 N, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 10 to 12 MPa. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only wet-basis moisture w to 0.40, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 700 to 600 kg dry solids. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only collection c to 0.80, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 27 to 17 m³ CH₄/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only cell area a to 300 m², holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 25 to 34 sample cells. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only valid intervals n to 1200, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 91.6667 to 83.3333 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
evidence: 針對「覆蓋層功能分工」，用已知容積箱和秤重核對密度，將鬆填、壓實與乾濕狀態分欄。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「降雨、蒸散與滲漏」，將雨量、量測排水與含水變化對齊，對未知項給區間而非強制零殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「低滲透層完整性」，核對試體飽和度、尺寸與水頭，再比較現場密實度及施工品質證據。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「表面排水坡度」，用固定基準點重測縱橫斷面，找出局部反坡而非只量兩端。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「差異沉陷與裂縫」，沿穩定基準重測沉陷網格，對照裂縫、積水和植生變化。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「膜材與接縫受力」，記錄試片尺寸、載入速率與破壞位置，區分母材、焊縫和夾具滑移。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「植生含水與季節」，保存稱重、乾燥方法及分樣紀錄，對比重複樣並檢查非水揮發損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「覆土甲烷氧化邊界」，把收集流量、表面通量與氣體組成併看，保留不可量測項的不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「巡查空間覆蓋」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「長期監測交接」，畫出缺值時間軸並保留校正、維護與通訊錯誤旗標，禁止把缺值填成零。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
evidenceEn: For Roles of cover layers, Check density using a known-volume container and scale, separating loose, compacted, wet and dry conditions. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage, Align rainfall, measured drainage and moisture change; bound unknown terms rather than forcing zero residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Integrity of the low-permeability layer, Verify saturation, dimensions and head before comparing field density and construction quality records. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Surface-drainage grade, Resurvey longitudinal and transverse sections against stable benchmarks to detect local reverse grades. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Differential settlement and cracking, Resurvey a settlement grid from stable benchmarks and compare cracks, ponding and vegetation changes. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Membrane and seam loading, Record specimen size, loading rate and failure location, distinguishing parent sheet, weld and grip slip. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Vegetation moisture and seasonality, Retain weighing, drying method and subsampling records and compare duplicates while checking non-water volatile loss. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Cover methane-oxidation boundary, Combine collected flow, surface flux and gas composition while retaining uncertainty in unmeasured terms. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Inspection spatial coverage, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Long-term monitoring handoff, Plot missing intervals with calibration, maintenance and communication flags; never replace missing values with zero. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
pitfalls: 把粒子密度當堆積密度會低估運輸或覆層需要體積。 在「覆蓋層功能分工」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
忽略儲水變化會把短期蓄水誤認為永久減滲。 在「降雨、蒸散與滲漏」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
試驗室低 K 不會排除現場接縫或穿刺形成的洩漏。 在「低滲透層完整性」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
端點高差正確仍可能在中間存在窪地。 在「表面排水坡度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
整體平均沉陷小，局部梯度仍可能導致破壞。 在「差異沉陷與裂縫」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只報最大拉力而不報尺寸，無法公平比較不同試片。 在「膜材與接縫受力」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
用濕重比較處理前後會把脫水誤認為固體去除。 在「植生含水與季節」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只從抽氣量反推生成量會把假定收集效率當成觀測。 在「覆土甲烷氧化邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「巡查空間覆蓋」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「長期監測交接」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
pitfallsEn: Using particle density as bulk density underestimates hauling or cover volume. Mark where this error can enter the Roles of cover layers flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Ignoring storage change mistakes short-term retention for permanent seepage reduction. Mark where this error can enter the Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Low laboratory K does not rule out leakage through field seams or punctures. Mark where this error can enter the Integrity of the low-permeability layer flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Correct endpoint elevations can still conceal a depression between them. Mark where this error can enter the Surface-drainage grade flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
A small mean settlement can coexist with damaging local gradients. Mark where this error can enter the Differential settlement and cracking flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Maximum force without specimen dimensions cannot compare samples fairly. Mark where this error can enter the Membrane and seam loading flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Comparing wet masses can mistake dewatering for solids removal. Mark where this error can enter the Vegetation moisture and seasonality flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Inferring generation from collected gas alone turns an assumed efficiency into an apparent observation. Mark where this error can enter the Cover methane-oxidation boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Inspection spatial coverage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Long-term monitoring handoff flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

courses.summary: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。
courses.summaryEn: The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.
